sites.name: Ban Gioc Waterfall
sites.event: One of the most beautiful and largest transboundary waterfalls in the world, located on the Quay Son River (Vietnam - China border).

sites.name: Pac Bo Special National Historical Site
sites.event: The place where President Ho Chi Minh first set foot back in his homeland (28/01/1941) after 30 years of traveling abroad to find a way to save the country and directly lead the revolution.

sites.name: Tran Hung Dao Forest Special National Historical Site
sites.event: The founding place of the Vietnam Armed Propaganda Unit for National Liberation (the predecessor of the Vietnam People's Army) on 22/12/1944.

place.commune: Tam Kim Commune, Hoa Tham Commune

sites.name: Nguom Ngao Cave
sites.event: A stunning limestone cave with a magical system of stalactites, whose name in the Tay language means 'Tiger Cave'.

sites.name: Thang Hen Lake
sites.event: The most beautiful mountain freshwater lake in the Thang Hen system of 36 lakes, associated with the legend of young man Sung.

sites.name: Mat Than Mountain (Thung Mountain)
sites.event: A unique mountain with a hole through its center about 50m in diameter, dubbed the 'Tuyet Tinh Coc' of Cao Bang.

sites.name: Dong Khe Victory Historical Site
sites.event: The site of the key opening battle of the 1950 Autumn-Winter Border Campaign, marking a major milestone in the growth of our army.

sites.name: Tomb of Heroic Martyr Kim Dong
sites.event: The resting place of Nong Van Den (Kim Dong) - the first leader of the Ho Chi Minh Young Pioneer Organization.

sites.name: Phat Tich Truc Lam Ban Gioc Pagoda
sites.event: The first pagoda built on the northern border of the country, carrying spiritual significance and guarding the frontier.

sites.name: Ma Phuc Pass
sites.event: The famous 7-tier pass, recognized by UNESCO as a unique geological heritage site within the Non Nuoc Cao Bang Geopark.

place.commune: Boundary of Quoc Toan Commune (Quang Hoa) and Nguyen Hue Commune (Hoa An)
place.district: Quang Hoa District, Hoa An District

sites.name: Phuc Sen Blacksmith Village
sites.event: The famous traditional blacksmith craft village of the Nung An people, with a history of hundreds of years.
